files_of_interest.role: Hosts the first caption \\caption{Retrieval results ...} which is the source of evidence_quote span [34,190).
Table body referenced by the first caption; the included four-column tabular reports BM25/DPR/BM25+DPR/ANCE Top-20/100 values for NQ and TQA.

Table body referenced by the SECOND caption (Relative gains in commercial search). Different columns and different caption: NOT a numerical result table for the metrics/datasets named in evidence span [34,190).

Original five-row Top-K retrieval table; commented out in the published build (\input commented out in Evaluation.tex). Provides the canonical numerical evidence in the wider paper but is NOT inside the chunk.

Surrounding prose. The only sentence connecting the evidence caption to a concrete system is on line 19: 'It also outperforms DPR in passage retrieval in OpenQA (Table~\ref{tab:openqa}).' This sentence lives in Evaluation.tex but is OUTSIDE the chunk boundaries.

scientific_substantiation_limits.structural_only: Each accepted assertion passes Gate 1 (schema), Gate 2 (ontology conformity) and Gate 3 (evidence integrity) of docs/specs/extraction-contract.md §8 against the canonical chunk text.
scientific_substantiation_limits.scientific_open: EVALUATES_ON requires 'Document reports experimental results on a dataset' (ontology.yaml lines 169-183). REPORTS_METRIC requires 'Document reports a metric in its results' (ontology.yaml lines 197-207). Both definitions are verified by the SAT example entries only; the quote-repair-v1 chunk shows the dataset/metric mentions and the words 'Retrieval results on' but no system-name, no numeric value, and no per-assertion prose separation. The remainder of the paper (Tables/openqa.tex and Evaluation.tex:19) supplies the per-dataset numerical evidence and the system binding, but is OUTSIDE the chunk and therefore NOT part of the V2 evidence-span contract.
scientific_substantiation_limits.confidence_label_not_review: The 'stated' confidence value comes from the model output, not from a human review (docs/specs/extraction-contract.md §8 + gold_set/GUIDELINES.md §6).
